headline: Pritchard's 30 powers Celtics past Bulls in NBA Cup opener

sections.label: 1st quarter
sections.text: Boston went up 22–12 on Paul George's dunk off a Josh Giddey turnover and led 33–18 with three minutes left. The 44–25 quarter was the Celtics' best opening period of the season.

sections.label: 2nd quarter
sections.text: Payton Pritchard's 26-footer made it 63–35 with 6:41 left in the half, and Jayson Tatum's finger roll and 3-pointer pushed the lead to 76–44, its peak of 32, with under two minutes to go. Pritchard had 20 points on 7-of-10 shooting at the break.

sections.label: 3rd quarter
sections.text: Chicago hit four 3-pointers by the middle of the quarter to trim the deficit to 86–66, and Boston managed 21 points, its lowest quarter of the night.

sections.label: 4th quarter
sections.text: Tatum's step-back made it 102–80 with 9:38 left; he later picked up his fifth foul and a technical with about five minutes to go. The Bulls won the quarter 37–26 after Boston pulled its starters.

performers.name: Payton Pritchard
performers.note: Led all scorers off the bench, with 20 of his points in the first half as Boston built a 29-point halftime lead.

performers.name: Jayson Tatum
performers.note: Scored inside and out in the 32-point second-quarter surge, though he picked up his fifth foul and a technical late.

performers.name: Paul George
performers.note: Led the Celtics in assists and helped turn Chicago's 16 turnovers into 21 points.

oppLine: Caleb Wilson had 23 points with six 3-pointers, Norman Powell added 16 and Matas Buzelis 14, and Jalen Smith grabbed 12 rebounds; Chicago shot 38% (35-of-92).
takeaway: A fourth straight win lifts Boston to 4–1 and a share of the NBA Cup Group C lead with Washington, which holds the point-differential edge (+16 to +14).
